message.content:
A medium-sized tomato (about 123 g) contains roughly **22 kcal**.  
The calorie count varies with size:

| Size | Weight (g) | Calories |
|------|------------|----------|
| Small | ~77 | ~15 kcal |
| Medium | ~123 | ~22 kcal |
| Large | ~182 | ~30 kcal |

So, for most everyday uses, you can round to about **20–25 kcal** per tomato.
